main_body: Green sofa seen from the front: a wide light backrest, a dark band, a seat cushion strip, a dark front apron, and two small legs
top_band: Rows 8-11 are light green with a cushion seam, but they read as a vertical cushion face below the backrest. The rows above (2-5) are the light backrest face. No clear horizontal seat surface is visible.
evidence: Column read at the middle: rows 0-1 dark back edge, rows 2-5 light backrest face, rows 6-7 dark band, rows 8-11 light cushion strip with a vertical seam, rows 12-14 dark apron, row 15 legs. The seat strip is about the same tone as the backrest. It has no distinct front-edge line and no eave shadow, and the seam makes it look like cushion fronts seen face-on. This is a front elevation, and the seat is not clearly seen from above.

style.evidence: The sofa uses roughly 3-4 greens: light, mid, dark, plus a darker outline. The backrest and cushions are large flat fills of one colour, with no grain, stitching dots or fabric texture. The outline is dark green, which suits the material. Next to the stall and well references, which have many tones and textured tiles, each tile carries only 2-4 colours. It is much thinner and flatter than the references.
